सोत्क, सोत्कंठ a.
1 Ardently
longing, impatiently eager,
anxious; as in सोत्कंठमालिंगनम्.
--2
Regreatful.
--3 Bewailing, sorrowing.
--ठं ind.
1 With ardent or eager
longing, anxiously; प्रोड्डीयेव
बलाकया सरभसं सोत्कंठमालिंगितः

सोत्प्रास a.
1 Excessive.
--2
Exaggerated.
--3 Ironical, sarcastic.
--सः Violent laughter.
--सः --सं
Ironical exaggeration, sarcasm,
irony; cf. व्याजस्तुति.

सोत्सव a. Festive, making
merry, joyous.

सोत्साह a. Vigorous, active,
energetic, persevering.
--हं ind.
Actively, energetically, carefully.

सोत्सुक a. Regretful, repining,
anxious, sorrowful.

सोत्सेध a. Raised, elevated,
high, lofty; सोत्सेधैः स्कंधदेशैः
